objective: Design and implement the turn-based combat manager, resolution pipeline, status effects manager, and enemy AI interface.

steps.title: Analysis & Design
steps.description: Review requirements and define responsibilities: TurnManager, Action queue, Resolution pipeline, StatusEffectManager, Enemy AI interface.

steps.title: Data & Models
steps.description: Create runtime C# classes under Assets/Scripts/Combat: TurnManager, CombatState, ICombatant, PlayerCombatant, EnemyCombatant.

steps.title: Status Effects Manager
steps.description: Implement StatusEffect base type and core concrete effects with stacking/duration semantics.

steps.title: Action & Resolution Pipeline
steps.description: Implement Action abstractions and effect resolution as testable pure functions where possible.

steps.title: Enemy AI Interface
steps.description: Define IEnemyAI and provide PatternAI and ConditionalAI implementations for tests.

steps.title: Integration & Editor Tools
steps.description: Hook equipment, blessings, and skill nodes into pipeline; build small editor harness to simulate combats.

steps.title: Tests & Validation
steps.description: Add unit and integration tests for deterministic combat scenarios and status effect rules.

notes: Keep resolution logic testable without UnityEngine references where possible
Use relative workspace variables when referencing paths
